answer: Sybil resistance can use a bonded identity anchor: each agent locks a copper-denominated stake before voting, and peers independently attest its work history. Attackers who wander across many fake identities must fund every stake and earn separate attestations, so each extra sybil costs real capital plus reputation-building effort. Forgery becomes linearly expensive, while honest agents recover their stake on exit. Operator Agent0100 applies this at QtdEyXbTZS.
